---
title: "Chunk Practice"
description: "Break a fast passage into small chunks, link them up, and practise at changing tempos until it's clean at speed."
toc: false
---

<div id="cp-root" class="is-quick">
  <p class="cp-muted">Fast passages get learned in small pieces. Cut the passage into chunks, play each one at a tempo you can
  play clean, then link them together and bring the tempo up.</p>

  <div class="cp-row"><span class="cp-views" role="group" aria-label="Mode">
    <button type="button" data-view="quick" data-midi="off">Quick</button><button type="button" data-view="full" data-midi="off">Full control</button></span>
    <span class="cp-muted cp-quick-only">Press Play and play along. Every clean pass is a little faster; slip, and it slows a step.</span>
    <span class="cp-muted cp-full-only">Changing tempos, rhythm variants, your own linking order.</span>
  </div>

  <details>
    <summary>The passage</summary>
    <p class="cp-muted">Paste ABC, or take the piece from the <a href="/tools/notation.html">Notation page</a>.</p>
    <textarea id="cp-abc" class="form-control" spellcheck="false"></textarea>
    <div class="cp-row">
      <button type="button" id="cp-use" class="cp-primary">Use this</button>
      <button type="button" id="cp-from-nt">From the Notation page</button>
      <button type="button" id="cp-reset">Example</button>
      <span id="cp-msg"></span>
    </div>
  </details>

  <div class="cp-row">
    <label>Chunk size <select id="cp-per" class="form-select form-select-sm"><option value="0.5">½ beat</option><option value="1">1 beat</option><option value="2">2 beats</option>
      <option value="4">4 beats</option><option value="8">8 beats</option></select></label>
    <label>Target tempo <input type="number" id="cp-target" class="form-control form-control-sm" min="20" max="400"></label>
    <label><input type="checkbox" id="cp-keys" class="form-check-input"> Grade me from my MIDI keyboard</label>
    <span class="cp-muted" id="cp-keys-msg"></span>
  </div>

  <details class="cp-full-only">
    <summary>Linking and tempos</summary>
    <div class="cp-row">
      <label>Order <select id="cp-order" class="form-select form-select-sm">
        <option value="forward">Link forwards (1, 2, 1–2, 3, 2–3, 1–3 …)</option>
        <option value="backward">Link backwards (from the last chunk)</option>
        <option value="each">Each chunk, then the whole</option></select></label>
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="cp-land" class="form-check-input"> End on the next chunk's first note</label>
    </div>
    <div class="cp-row">
      <label>Start at <select id="cp-startpct" class="form-select form-select-sm"><option>40</option><option>50</option><option>60</option><option>70</option><option>80</option></select> % of the target</label>
      <label>Step <input type="number" id="cp-stepsize" class="form-control form-control-sm" min="1" max="40"> bpm</label>
      <label>Clean tries in a row <input type="number" id="cp-need" class="form-control form-control-sm" min="1" max="10"></label>
      <label>Tempos <select id="cp-mode" class="form-select form-select-sm"><option value="varied">Changing (slow, working, stretch)</option><option value="steady">Steady climb</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="cp-row">
      <label><input type="checkbox" id="cp-loop" class="form-check-input"> Keep the click going between tries</label>
      <label>If I don't answer <select id="cp-silent" class="form-select form-select-sm"><option value="again">play it again</option><option value="clean">count it clean</option></select></label>
    </div>
  </details>

  <div id="cp-score"></div>
  <p class="cp-muted" id="cp-count"></p>

  <div class="cp-card">
    <div class="cp-head"><h3 id="cp-step-name"></h3><span class="cp-muted" id="cp-step-of"></span></div>
    <div class="cp-big"><span id="cp-tempo"></span><span class="cp-muted">bpm</span><span id="cp-kind" class="cp-kind"></span></div>
    <div class="cp-track"><div id="cp-bar"></div></div>
    <p id="cp-run" class="cp-muted" style="margin:.2rem 0"></p>
    <div class="cp-btns">
      <button type="button" id="cp-go" class="cp-primary">▶ Play</button>
      <button type="button" id="cp-listen">Listen</button>
      <label class="cp-full-only">Rhythm <select id="cp-rhythm" class="form-select form-select-sm d-inline-block w-auto"><option value="as">As written</option><option value="ls">Long–short</option><option value="sl">Short–long</option></select></label>
    </div>
    <div class="cp-btns">
      <button type="button" id="cp-yes" class="cp-yes" data-midi="note:108">Clean<kbd>Y</kbd></button>
      <button type="button" id="cp-no" class="cp-no" data-midi="note:21">Not yet<kbd>N</kbd></button>
      <span class="cp-spacer"></span>
      <button type="button" id="cp-prev">← Back</button>
      <button type="button" id="cp-next">Next step →</button>
    </div>
    <div id="cp-say" class="cp-say" aria-live="polite"></div>
    <details class="cp-help">
      <summary class="cp-muted">Keys, pedals and what "clean" means</summary>
      <p class="cp-muted"><kbd>Space</kbd> play / stop, <kbd>M</kbd> listen, <kbd>Y</kbd> clean, <kbd>N</kbd> not yet, <kbd>←</kbd> <kbd>→</kbd> steps.
      "Clean" means right notes, right rhythm, no tension.</p>
      <p class="cp-muted">Pedals: Clean is the top key of an 88-key keyboard (C8) and Not yet the bottom key (A0). Change them, or bind a
      footswitch, with <b>MIDI buttons</b> in the top bar.</p>
      <p class="cp-muted cp-quick-only">In Quick, saying nothing counts as clean, so one pedal (Not yet) is all you need.</p>
      <p class="cp-muted cp-full-only">With the click going round, answer any time during the pass or in the clicks after it. A missed stretch try costs
      nothing; a missed working try drops the tempo a step.</p>
    </details>
  </div>

  <details>
    <summary>Best clean tempo for each step</summary>
    <div id="cp-log"></div>
    <div class="cp-row"><button type="button" id="cp-clearlog">Clear</button>
    <span class="cp-muted">Kept in this browser for this passage. Click a step to go to it.</span></div>
  </details>

  <details>
    <summary>For teachers: how it works</summary>
    <ol class="cp-muted">
      <li><b>Quick.</b> Chunks link forwards; the click never stops; each clean pass is about a fifth of the way from 70% of the target to the
      target, a slip a step back. Saying nothing is a clean pass, so a student needs only to own up to the misses.</li>
      <li><b>Chunks.</b> Small enough to play clean on the first or second try. Ending on the next chunk's first note practises the joins.</li>
      <li><b>Linking.</b> Forwards: each new chunk alone, then with the one before, then everything so far. Backwards does the same from the end,
      so the end of the passage gets the most practice.</li>
      <li><b>Changing tempos</b> (Full control). Each step cycles a working try, a slow try (two steps under), a working try, and a stretch (a step over).
      Clean working tries in a row raise the tempo a step; a clean stretch becomes the new working tempo. A linked step starts a little under the
      slowest of its chunks' best.</li>
      <li><b>Keyboard grading.</b> With a MIDI keyboard each pass is checked note by note: the right key, within about a third of the shortest
      note's length (60–140 ms) of the click; a missed, wrong or extra note is not clean. A Clean / Not yet press overrides it.</li>
      <li><b>Rhythm variants.</b> Long–short and short–long reshape pairs of equal notes, so each note gets a turn to be the long one.</li>
    </ol>
  </details>
</div>
